question: When was the Monetary Policy Framework Agreement (MPFA) signed between the Government of India and the Reserve Bank?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Feb 20 2015 **__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Monetary Policy Framework Agreement (MPFA)** was signed between the **Government of India** and the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** on **February 20, 2015**.
 
• The MPFA established a framework for **monetary policy coordination**, focusing on **inflation targeting** as its key goal.
 
• Under this agreement, the **RBI** was tasked with maintaining inflation within a specified range (4% with a tolerance of ±2%). *Hence, the correct answer is the date mentioned in Option 4.*
 
• The signing of MPFA marked a major shift in India's monetary policy framework, aligning it with **global best practices**.
 
• This agreement enhanced the accountability and transparency of the RBI in conducting monetary policy. *Hence, the date February 20, 2015 is correct.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Significance of the Monetary Policy Framework Agreement:**

 
 
• The MPFA was signed to provide a structured approach to **inflation control** and to ensure economic stability.
 
• The agreement formally introduced the concept of **inflation targeting** to India's monetary policy, with the **Consumer Price Index (CPI)** as the benchmark.
 
 
 
• **Role of the Reserve Bank of India under MPFA:**
 
 
• The RBI was entrusted with the responsibility of ensuring that inflation remains within the agreed-upon range of **2% to 6%**.
 
• If inflation deviates from this range, the RBI is required to provide a detailed explanation to the **Government of India**, outlining the causes and proposed corrective actions.
 
 
 
• **Global Context:**
 
 
• Inflation targeting is a widely adopted monetary policy approach globally, implemented by central banks in countries like **United Kingdom**, **Australia**, and **Canada**.
 
• India's adoption of MPFA was a step toward aligning its monetary policy with **international standards**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Inflation Targeting Framework:**

 
 
• The target for inflation was set at **4%**, with an upper tolerance limit of **6%** and a lower limit of **2%**.
 
• This framework aimed to achieve macroeconomic stability and sustainable growth in the economy.
 
 
 
• **Impact of MPFA:**
 
 
• The agreement improved **coordination** between the government and RBI, leading to better policy alignment.
 
• It contributed to a significant reduction in inflation rates in subsequent years, supporting India's growth trajectory.
